items.summary: CTO disposition: maintain containment-only execution. No new production work, requeues, deployments, dependencies, telemetry, spend, monetization changes, or external outreach are safely authorized this cycle. Continue existing repair-or-close, measurement, attribution, legal, and security work using recorded evidence only.

Continue existing failure containment and measurement reconciliation. Do not requeue failed or cancelled work until root cause, isolated validation, rollback, ownership, deduplication, and reviewer evidence are documented.

Continue the existing bounded read-only security evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Preserve private launch gates and do not access credentials, change permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, exploit targets, or conduct outreach.

The fleet control-plane reconciliation proposal is technically feasible, isolated, reversible, and measurable from existing records, but it is not queue-safe this cycle because it duplicates active containment, failure-review, and measurement work. Retain it as deferred backlog until current gates clear.
